docs.title: Welcome to Demo Docs
docs.text: This is a sample MkDocs site created with Material for MkDocs.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Fast documentation generation
  • Clean Markdown workflow
  • Easy publishing to GitHub Pages or other static hosting

docs.title: Next step
docs.text: Open the Getting Started page for setup instructions.

docs.title: Run locally
docs.text:
mkdocs serve

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8000 in your browser.

docs.title: Build for production
docs.text:
mkdocs build

The generated site will be in the site/ directory.
